summary: Moved all access checks into docshelf/access.py and gave each command module a RULES value that reproduces its old behavior; the existing tests pass and tests/test_access.py is added. Quirks were kept as they were (for example edit lets any granter's * grant count, delegates cannot share, and suspension and end rules differ per command). I did not run the old and new packages side by side, because the original code was overwritten.
